英文句子: I get up at six thirty every morning.
中文句子: 我每天早上六点半起床。

英文句子: I wash my face and brush my teeth.
I have breakfast with my family.
I go to school by bike.
I have four classes in the morning.
At noon I eat lunch at school.
After school I do my homework.
I read a book before bed.
I go to bed at nine o'clock.
